title: Velocity #1 Image Top Cow 1995 Cyberforce Kurt Busiek Aaron Sowd Cover
condition_description: Bright, clean white cover with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Velocity #1 (November 1995), Image Comics / Top Cow - first issue of the Cyberforce spin-off miniseries starring Velocity. Written by Kurt Busiek, pencils by Anthony Chun; cover by Aaron Sowd. $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: Marc Silvestri's Ripclaw #1 ad.

Condition: bright, clean white cover with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
